### Page Role & Goal
This is the landing page for Hearthstone Law, a boutique estate planning firm. Every design decision must immediately communicate trust, warmth, permanence, and legal authority. The page converts first-time visitors into consultation bookings by moving them through an emotional arc: attention → orientation → social proof → action.

---

**The hero's oversized embossed display word "LEGACY" — rendered in Polished Brass (#B08A4E) at ~160–180px, Libre Baskerville bold, set behind the hero headline as a typographic watermark anchoring the composition.** It bleeds off the right edge of the hero panel, partially cropped, sitting at roughly 40% opacity so it reads as a material impression pressed into the Vault Slate surface — like a notarial seal or a letterpress plate. This is the page's unmistakable skeuomorphic-modern signature: type used as material texture, not just communication. It belongs to this aesthetic because skeuomorphic design treats surfaces as physical objects with embedded marks, stamps, and impressions. It belongs to this brand because "legacy" is the firm's core promise. It lives in Section 1 (hero) and sets the tonal register for everything that follows.

---

### Section Sequence & Rhythm
1. **Hero (Section 1):** Maximum density, dark surface, full-bleed. The page opens at its heaviest visual weight — Vault Slate panel, the embossed "LEGACY" watermark, serif headline at display scale, the protective-home illustration anchored bottom-right overlapping the panel edge. Asymmetric left-aligned text column occupying ~55% of width.
2. **Feature Grid (Section 2):** Shift to the warm Hearthstone Linen surface. Four service cards arranged in a 2×2 grid with strong skeuomorphic card depth — raised Inlaid Cream surfaces, Polished Brass border accents, Chambered Shadow drop shadows. Moderate density with breathing room between cards. Section header is left-aligned, not centered.
3. **Testimonials (Section 3):** A full-bleed Notary Sage (#4A5E52) dark-mid panel that breaks the linen/dark alternation and introduces a third surface color. Cards are horizontal scroll tiles on mobile, three-column on desktop. Pull-quote marks in Polished Brass at oversized scale (120px) anchor each card as a skeuomorphic material ornament. This is the densest typographic section.
4. **CTA (Section 4):** Return to Vault Slate dark surface for closure and authority. Centered composition — justified by the heritage-adjacent legal gravitas of a closing statement. - Hero: tight internal padding (64px top/bottom), content fills the stage

- Testimonials: 64px vertical padding, cards have internal 32px padding

- Card metadata: Montserrat, 10px, Brushed Pewter

- Hero: stacks vertically on mobile, illustration moves behind text at 60% opacity as a background layer; watermark scales to 80px and remains partially cropped right

All fonts (Libre Baskerville, Source Sans 3, Montserrat), all color tokens, and all surface logic follow the shared design system exactly. Our Practice Areas

Every Tool You Need to Protect Your Legacy

Estate planning is not one-size-fits-all. Explore our full range of services and find the plan that fits your family.

Five Practice Areas
Core Services

Plans Designed for Every Stage of Life

Last Will & Testament

A legally binding document that specifies how your assets will be distributed, names guardians for minor children, and appoints an executor to carry out your wishes. Ideal for individuals and families at any asset level.

Ideal for · Individuals, parents with minor children

Revocable Living Trust

A flexible trust that holds your assets during your lifetime and transfers them to beneficiaries without probate. Maintains privacy and allows you to retain full control while you are living.

Ideal for · Homeowners, blended families

Durable Power of Attorney

Designates a trusted agent to manage your financial affairs — paying bills, managing investments, filing taxes — if you become unable to do so yourself.

Ideal for · All adults, especially with aging parents

Healthcare Directive & Living Will

Documents your medical treatment preferences and designates a healthcare proxy to make decisions on your behalf if you are incapacitated.

Ideal for · All adults 18 and older

Special Needs Trust

Provides for a family member with disabilities without disqualifying them from government benefits such as Medicaid or SSI. Carefully structured to supplement, not replace, public assistance.

Ideal for · Families with a disabled dependent

Business Succession Planning

Ensures your business continues smoothly after your retirement, incapacity, or death. Includes buy-sell agreements, ownership transfer strategies, and key-person planning.

Ideal for · Business owners, entrepreneurs

Our Story

Built on the Belief That Every Family Deserves a Plan

Hearthstone Law was founded on the conviction that estate planning is one of the most profound acts of love a person can undertake.

Why We Do This Work

A Practice Born from Personal Experience

Make thoughtful, thorough estate planning accessible to every family.

Founding attorney Eleanor Marsh began her career at a large regional firm, where she watched families navigate the chaos of losing a loved one without a plan in place. She saw estates tied up in probate for years, sibling relationships fractured over ambiguous wills, and grieving spouses left without access to basic funds. In 2009, she opened Hearthstone Law with a singular mission: to make thoughtful, thorough estate planning accessible to every family — not just the wealthy few. Today, the firm has helped over 1,400 families across the region put plans in place they can trust.

The Team

Attorneys Who Listen First, Then Plan

Our attorneys combine deep legal expertise with a genuine commitment to understanding each client's unique family situation.

EM
Founding Attorney

Eleanor Marsh, J.D., LL.M.

Founding attorney and estate planning specialist with 20+ years of experience. Eleanor earned her LL.M. in Taxation from Georgetown and has been recognized as a Top Estate Planning Attorney by the State Bar Association for six consecutive years.

JO
Senior Associate

James Okafor, J.D.

James focuses on trust administration, business succession planning, and high-net-worth estate strategies. He brings 12 years of experience and a reputation for making complex structures easy to understand.

PN
Associate Attorney

Priya Nair, J.D.

Priya specializes in blended family estate planning, special needs trusts, and Medicaid planning. She is known for her empathetic approach and meticulous attention to detail.

Our Values

The Principles That Guide Every Plan We Write

Clarity Over Complexity

We translate legal language into plain English so you always understand exactly what your documents say and why.

Plans That Fit Your Life

No templates. Every estate plan is built around your specific family, assets, and intentions.

Relationships, Not Transactions

We maintain long-term relationships with clients, updating plans as life changes so your estate plan always reflects your current wishes.

Accessible Expertise

Exceptional estate planning should not be a luxury. We offer transparent pricing and flexible consultations to serve families at every stage.
